title.zh-CN: 职业实践路线图

pacePolicy.en: Advance by demonstrated milestones and adapt the pace to your study time. Stages have no fixed duration or promise of job readiness. Check linked resources for provider-supplied time estimates and the actual learning language.
pacePolicy.zh-CN: 达到可展示的里程碑后再进阶，并按可用学习时间调整节奏。各阶段没有固定时长，也不承诺就业准备程度。课程时长及实际学习语言以关联资源中的提供方信息为准。

scope.en: Use invented data, fictional cases, paper models, or local simulations only. Projects do not authorize regulated practice, interaction with real participants, fieldwork, or access to live systems. Catalog education pathways describe typical routes. Confirm local requirements separately, especially for licensed occupations.
scope.zh-CN: 仅使用虚构数据、虚构案例、纸面模型或本地仿真。项目不授权开展受监管职业活动、与真实参与者互动、实地作业或接入生产系统。目录中的教育路径描述常见路线；执业岗位尤其需要另行确认当地要求。

resource.en: A catalog-skill match shares a normalized skill or tag. Field-context material offers broader background and may use examples from a different specialty.
resource.zh-CN: 目录技能匹配表示资源与职业共享规范化技能或标签。领域背景资源提供更宽泛的知识，可能采用其他专长方向的示例。

challenge.en: A direct profession match lists this profession in the challenge dataset. Transferable practice links to a neighboring scenario that develops a related method. Join by ID to show original descriptions and rubrics.
challenge.zh-CN: 直接职业匹配表示挑战数据列出了该职业。可迁移练习关联培养相关方法的邻近场景。按标识符关联数据以显示原始说明和评分标准。

stage.en: Resource and challenge links appear at their source difficulty. Mixed-level collections appear with the foundations stage. Other stages use the roadmap projects.
stage.zh-CN: 资源和挑战按其原始难度归入对应阶段。混合难度资源集归入基础阶段，其余阶段使用路线图项目。

readiness.en: Use the catalog education pathway for context. Begin this project with a fictional example and record any assumptions you need.
readiness.zh-CN: 将目录中的教育路径作为背景参考。用虚构示例开始项目，并记录必要假设。

readiness.en: Bring a first version that meets the beginner milestone, or comparable work you can explain.
readiness.zh-CN: 准备一版达到基础里程碑的成果，或一份可以解释的同等作品。

readiness.en: Bring the applied project with its comparison and a record of assumptions. Choose a second fictional variation without external data.
readiness.zh-CN: 准备含对照结果及假设记录的应用项目，不使用外部数据，独立设置第二种虚构变化。

instructions.en: Build on the comparison. Add a second fictional variation related to the first. Specify in advance what would show a failure, run the check, and document one limitation or unresolved tradeoff.
